post.description: Create an AccordTrace service-recorded proof bound to the canonical SHA-256 digest of submitted JSON-compatible data. Submitted data is not stored in the proof record. When an Ed25519 issuer key is configured the proof also carries an issuer signature; otherwise integrity_mode is service_recorded_hash and issuer is null.

503.description: A configured issuer signing key is invalid

post.description: Verify the AccordTrace service record, verify an issuer signature when present, and optionally compare supplied data or a supplied hash to the proof digest.

200.description: Verification result with integrity_mode, hash_match and signature_valid

post.description: Compute the AccordTrace canonical SHA-256 digest without creating a proof.
Streamable-HTTP JSON-RPC MCP endpoint for AccordTrace proof tools.
